'''Rando M' Kabe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who operated for the [[Valarian Syndicate]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:Remodeling" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] sent a spacer to infiltrate the [[Valarian Depot]] to retrieve [[Droid/Legends|droid]] disciplinary devices stolen by the Valarians. The spacer first loaded EV-9D9's cargo into Rando M' Kabe's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. The spacer then killed Rando M' Kabe and finally reprogrammed the shuttle for an automated flight out of the depot.<ref name="SWG:Remodeling" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MercenaryTemplateMale.png|thumb|right|250px|Possible depictions of Rando M' Kabe.]]
[[File:PilotFemaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated female depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Rando M' Kabe was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:Remodeling" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rando M' Kabe was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of the quest [[:w:c:swg:Remodeling|Remodeling]], in which players working for [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] had to perform tasks at the Valarian Depot, which included killing Rando M' Kabe.<ref name="SWG:Remodeling" />
